data.long_meaning: The name Hannahiel is derived from the Hebrew words 'hannah' meaning grace, and 'el' meaning God. In Hebrew tradition, the name Hannahiel is a representation of God's divine favor and protection. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hannahiel usually hope their child will grow to embody grace of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: חנהאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חנהאל הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אל חנן אותי' או 'חנינה של אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'חנה' שפירושה 'חנינה' או 'רחם', ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם חנהאל מופיע בתקופת התלמוד ומשמש כשם לאישיות רוחנית שזוכה לחסד אלוהי.

in_greek.name: Χαναηλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Χαναηλ είναι ένα Εβραϊκό όνομα που σημαίνει 'Χάρις του Θεού' ή 'Το έλεος του Θεού'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις Εβραϊκές λέξεις 'Χανα' που σημαίνει 'έλεος' ή 'χάρις', και 'Θεός' που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα Χαναηλ χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην αρχαία Εκκλησία και συμβολίζει τη χάρη και το έλεος του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Hannahiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Hannahiel nomen Hebraeum est quod significat 'Dei gratia mea' vel 'Misericordia Dei'. Nomen ex duobus verbis Hebraeis componitur: 'Channah' quod significat 'gratia' vel 'misericordia', et 'El' quod significat 'Deus'. Nomen Hannahiel in primo usu Ecclesiae antiquae invenitur et significat gratiam et misericordiam Dei.

in_english.name: Hannahiel
in_english.long_meaning: Hannahiel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'God's grace' or 'God's favor'. It is composed of two Hebrew words: 'Channah' (חנה), meaning 'grace' or 'favor', and 'El' (אל), meaning 'God'. The name Hannahiel has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who has received God's grace and favor. It symbolizes a deep spiritual connection with God and reflects the values of humility, gratitude, and devotion.

The name Hannahiel encourages individuals to trust in the divine grace of God and to strive for a closer relationship with Him.
